name: ValveSoftware/GameNetworkingSockets
description: Valve's internal game networking transport layer providing reliable/unreliable UDP messages, P2P NAT traversal, message fragmentation, and AES-GCM encryption; same API as Steam Datagram Relay.
score_rationale: Essential networking library from Valve with 9.3k stars, battle-tested in production on Steam with encrypted P2P NAT traversal and the same API as the commercial Steam SDK.
summary: Valve's battle-tested P2P networking with encrypted NAT traversal
